name: Neurotensin orchestrates valence assignment in the amygdala
description: Supervised the conversion of a study of valence assignment in the mouse amygdala, combining OpenEphys recordings and their Plexon spike sorting with the trials of a Pavlovian discrimination task, behavior video, DeepLabCut pose estimates and confocal histology, alongside fiber photometry from a second cohort.
Resulted in the publication of a total **575 GB** of mouse electrophysiology, photometry, behavioral and histology data on the NIH data archive.
